title: Valid Elements in an Array
summary: Given an integer array nums, identify elements that are strictly greater than all elements to their left or to their right.
statement: Given an integer array nums, identify elements that are strictly greater than all elements to their left or to their right. The first and last elements of the array are always considered valid. Return an array containing all valid elements in the same order as they appear in nums.
constraints: The first and last values are always valid.
An interior value is valid when it is strictly greater than every value on at least one side.
Return valid values in their original order.
hints: Precompute the maximum strictly to each index’s right.
Maintain the maximum strictly to the left during a forward scan.
Accept endpoints or a strict comparison against either side maximum.
The two running summaries represent every value on each complete side.
editorial: The two running summaries represent every value on each complete side.

tests.explanation: The endpoints qualify, and 2, 4, and 3 each dominate at least one complete side.
Every value dominates all values to its right, so all three qualify.
